summary: Frontend-only smoke test of UI navigation restructure (sidebar 5-section grouping + 6 standalone routes extracted from FrameworksPage). All targets PASS. Login (demo-admin), sidebar headers, 15 nav data-testids, all 17 routes (6 new + 11 existing), legacy redirects (/policy-library, /audits), no extracted-feature tabs left in FrameworksPage, active-state highlighting, and logout — every check green. Zero JS page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js SIDEBAR_NAV uses idx as React key for section rows (line 138). If sections were ever reordered dynamically, this could cause reconciliation issues. Currently static, so low priority.
App.js does not register a 404/catch-all <Route path='*'> — any unknown path silently renders nothing. Consider adding a NotFound route or fallback Navigate.
Layout.js fetchTrialStatus & fetchUnreadCount swallow errors with empty try/catch — fine for resilience but masks real backend issues during dev.

Active-state matcher uses location.pathname.startsWith(item.href + '/'). For href='/risks' there is no nested children, but for /policies vs /policy-engine the exact-match guard (===) prevents false positives — verified PASS during test.
test_credentials: demo-admin@grc.com / DemoAdmin123! — works via [data-testid=demo-admin-login-button] one-click and via form (login-submit-button).
